## Problem
A clear and concise description of the operational problem or workflow limitation. Example: *"When diagnosing database issues, we need real-time connection pool latency histograms..."*

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it integrates with the LangGraph state machine or Hindsight memory layer.

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you have considered.

## Why It Fits EpistemicOps
Explain how this aligns with persistent SRE operational memory, bounded read-only investigation, or learning-loop comparisons.
